intro: Download reproduce.csv (or copy it from the preview) and compute the two results below in a spreadsheet or Python. Record the analysis conditions you actually used — the validator checks both your number and your method.
steps: Filter the rows where Year = 2024 and confirm there are 12 months.
Average the 12 Anomaly_C values. Keep at least 2 decimal places.
Compute the annual mean for every year from 1975 to 2024 (50 values).
Fit an ordinary least-squares line (Year on the x-axis, annual mean on the y-axis). In a spreadsheet use =SLOPE(y_range, x_range).
Convert the slope from °C per year to °C per decade and keep at least 3 decimal places.
rounding: Do not round intermediate results. Report the final value with at least the stated number of decimals. A result is VALID when |your value − reference| ≤ tolerance.
